matrix.comment: The standing comparison (docs/development/benchmarks.md). Only the frame generation kind is a KSP start of its own; the upscaler, raytracing and Ray Reconstruction (the probe's mod.<key> keys), frame generation on and off and the latency models (the proxy's live keys) are set in turn inside each start. The raytracing's rtBlas*, rtTlasFastTrace and rtMegaGeometry keys go into proxy_load: the meshes are built at the flight's start, before the first phase, so a comparison of them takes a run of its own with other values there; each start's record holds the proxy's lines of its large mesh builds (rt_builds). The radiance cache (the proxy's live rtRadianceCache) is a rendering of its own for one technique and raytracing mode, with the latency models it names; every other phase has it off. So are the opacity micromaps (the proxy's live rtOpacityMicromaps), the last rendering of the start: the first 1 makes the raytracing's pipelines with micromap support, which they keep, and the meshes' structures are rebuilt with them once their micromaps are baked, in the rendering's first seconds; every other phase has it 0. A frame generation kind may write values into the DLSS-G package's ini for its start (dlssg_ini, section by section) and name the renderings it is measured with (only): dlssg-c is the package's preset C ([DLSSG] Preset), with FSR 3 at RT Off and Full and no latency model, as a kind of dlssg for the checks; both DLSS-G starts set [Logging] FrameTiming=1, which writes the GPU time of the frame generation evaluates per frame to the dlssg-logs copied beside the raw logs. Groups: the matrix's own lists are the main group, the default run. Every entry of "groups" is the matrix with its own values over it (lists of ids or of {"extends": id, ...} for techniques, frame_generation and latency; the other keys replace, proxy_load and mod_settings merge), run by `run --group <id>`; "scenes" and "variants" multiply its starts (a variant's proxy_load goes into the proxy at load, a start of its own), and "tweaks" are renderings of their own (live proxy keys, "tweak_defaults" the values every other phase has). A frame generation kind with "steps" is measured at each multiplier (the mod's frameGenerationMultiplier through the probe's mod.<key>).
matrix.main_description: Every upscaler with raytracing off and full, every frame generation kind, every latency model, plus the radiance cache and the opacity micromaps on FSR 3 at raytracing Full. The default run.

grass.name: a field of Parallax's grass 5 km from the pad

groups.name: Raytracing modes
groups.description: Raytracing Off, Shadows, Light and Full for FSR 3 and DLSS (Ray Reconstruction on and off), frame generation off and FSR's.

groups.name: Frame generation steps
groups.description: DLSS-G at 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x and Dynamic with the package's MaxGeneratedFrames raised to 5, set live through the mod's frameGenerationMultiplier, for FSR 3 at raytracing Off and Full; FSR's frame generation and no frame generation as the references. The shown/rendered column is what the GPU and the driver delivered.

groups.name: DLSS-G presets
groups.description: The package's preset Auto and preset C with every upscaler at raytracing Off and Full, no latency model; FSR's frame generation and no frame generation as the references.

groups.name: Latency brake targets
groups.description: The latency brake at 4 ms (the default), 2 ms and 1 ms for FSR 3 at raytracing Off and Full, with no frame generation, FSR's and DLSS-G; no brake as the reference.

groups.name: Acceleration structure builds
groups.description: How the meshes' acceleration structures are built, one KSP start per variant (they are built at the flight's start): the start's slowest build frame and the frame rate of its first phases, FSR 3 at raytracing Full.

groups.name: Grass and terrain
groups.description: The launch pad and a field of Parallax's grass 5 km away (-redefinitionProbeGrass), FSR 3 at every raytracing mode, then at Full the radiance cache, the cut-out tests (rtCutoutTest 1 and 2, the ceiling of what the alpha tests cost) and, last, the opacity micromaps; frame generation off and FSR's.
